geometryIdentity.metric: Exact position/index typed-buffer bytes plus array type/item size/count. Object ownership and exact geometry content are separate; neither counts semantic shapes, designs or creation units.

inspection.scope: Three-sided shallow projecting freestanding facade trial; closed wood, fixed thin glass, fixed lattice and relief on a deep sill/broad base. Wood-only openings are intentionally blocked by fixed glass; the rear cavity has separate finite all-part clear routes. No mounted building, operable window, seal, optics or contractor construction.

audit.scope: One fixed authored three-face shallow bay-window facade candidate. Closed beveled wood, stationary glass and lattice, broad sill/plinth and four flat supports. Glass intentionally blocks wood-only pane apertures; rear-cavity all-part routes are distinct.

audit.limits: Finite selected rays, strict shared material points, mesh-buffer/topology/crossing checks and flat sole samples. No full surface sealing/contact, glass optics, wind/weather/load/stability, mounted wall, continuous safety, body fit or normal contractor/acquisition/placement/save. Witness counts are not unique test counts.

compiledWorldPlacement.contactSupportKind: four separate actual flat underside pad meshes

originalSpriteEnvelopeClearance.method: sphere enclosing all four full raw Sprite quad corners from actual world scale/center; sphere-to-conservative-3D-pose-envelope distance; includes faint/transparent corners without cropping

compiledWorldPlacement.buildingProxyScope: actual current place-group mesh AABBs only; not full building geometry or transparent original-art fixture volume clearance

meadowInstances.scope: every actual current meadow instance geometry AABB transformed by its actual instance and world matrix, expanded .018 in all axes; current finite matrices and authored animation allowance, no all-frame proof

shoreline.method: every actual dry-land boundary segment against entire bay_window XZ AABB

compiledWorldPlacement.limits: one fixed authored standalone bay_window pose at one synthetic current-default-world site;20 finite sole/floor ray pairs on four actual flat underside pads,63 finite walkability samples and conservative current road, original-card, meadow, shore and building-proxy envelope clearances. These finite witnesses do not verify full pad-surface contact, support stability, load, physical behavior, body fit, whole-world placement or all-camera visibility

compiledWorldScope: Existing current Scene after synchronous construction/tree-road correction. Node has no DOM or original-art decode; native originalArt-ready Scene/visual views remain separate.
